acip: BDAG GI MTHUS BDAG GI MING THOS NAS BLA NA MED PA YANG DAG PAR RDZOGS PA'I BYANG CHUB MNGON PAR RDZOGS PAR SANGS RGYAS KYI BAR DU LAS KYI SGRIB PA THAMS CAD YONGS SU BYANG BAR GYUR CIG ,NYE BA'I NYON MONGS PA RNAMS DANG BRAL BAR GYUR CIG
wylie: bdag gi mthus bdag gi ming thos nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig ,nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang bral bar gyur cig
english: But by my mystic power, may they hear my name; and up until the day that they reach their own matchless, perfect, and total enlightenment, may all their karmic obstacles be cleaned from them; may they be freed from even lesser forms of the negative emotions.
